lines: All this, become Yours without remainder, now appears to me by the power of Your grace.
You, Maheśa, are ever my own self — made of You, all is mine through You.
sanskrit_cite: tvanmayam etad aśeṣam idānīṃ bhāti mama tvadanugrahaśaktyā tvaṃ ca maheśa sadaiva mamātmā svātmamayaṃ mama tena samastam
notes: svātmamaya kept constitutive (‘made of You’), not identity — see NOTE boundary
